title: Attending Raith Rovers exorcism 'exactly what a prime minister should be doing'
excerpt: HELLO there, and first an issue many of you are facing this autumn: militant pro-Palestine leftists. They’ve infiltrated the Greens and it could be your garden next.
content:
HELLO there, and first an issue many of you are facing this autumn: militant pro-Palestine leftists. They’ve infiltrated the Greens and it could be your garden next. 

You have to watch out for these insidious little devils, because let them run rampant and soon your whole lawn will be a toxic morass of anti-Semitism. One garden I know had to hire a Starmer to clean them out, which is unpleasant and expensive.

To begin with, keep a close eye on your grassroots. It might seem like an area you can leave to fend for itself but they will creep in there, often due to online co-ordination, and before you know it they’re overrun.

Look out for the key signs: not just the flags but an unhealthy focus on UN resolutions and boycotts. Harmless initially but soon you won’t even be able to silently repot in your greenhouse without being accused of complicity in genocide.

Now, they will disguise themselves under names like Youth Liberation and Activists for Peace. Don’t be fooled. Test them out for a monomaniacal focus on one specific issue which entwines around everything else, I can’t tell you how common that is.

You’re sympathetic to their cause? Oh we all are. That’s how they get in. But let that sympathy blossom and soon your herbaceous borders are taking difficult-to-defend positions on NATO expansionism and your parrotia persica’s on Russia Today.

So watch for the signs, root it out and don’t worry about them calling you a tool of the Zionist bloc. Though in your case, Mr Polanski, it’s got right into your public perceptions. You might have to leave it fallow for a season or two.
